meta.name: ai-search-optimization
meta.description: Optimizes for AI assistants and AI-generated answers — being retrievable, being cited, and being represented accurately when a model answers on your behalf. Use this when traffic is shifting from links to AI answers, when a brand is misrepresented or absent in AI responses, when planning content for retrieval rather than ranking, or when deciding how AI search changes an existing SEO program.

counter.description: 静态文本估算: CJK 字符 + 拉丁词 + 符号混合计数;不代表任一模型真实 tokenizer。单文本文件 >256KB 或 symlink 逃逸包外的不计入。

copy.tagline: 让品牌在 AI 答案中被准确呈现与引用
copy.fit_line: 适合你,如果品牌在 AI 回答中的表现让你担忧,想主动优化被检索与引用的效果。
copy.tagline_en: Get your brand accurately cited in AI-generated answers
copy.fit_line_en: For you if you worry about how AI answers present your brand and want better visibility.

howto.what: 装上后,Claude会从“被引用”而非“被点击”的角度,教你:把答案写在标题下第一句、用真实标题和列表、定义自己的术语、让全站事实一致,并定期请AI描述你公司,从源头纠错;衡量用引用次数和品牌搜索。
howto.when: 当流量从链接转向AI答案、品牌在AI回复里缺失或被说错、准备按“可被检索”而不是“排名”来规划内容等场景时触发。

say.text: 帮我检查这页在AI回答里会不会被准确引用
say.note: Claude会按技能标准逐条检查可引用性。

say.text: 把“我们是什么”的答案前置到第一段并配个真实标题
say.note: 这样被截取的段落也能独立成立。

say.text: 我的品牌在几个AI助手口中说法不一致,帮我找来源
say.note: Claude会教你从源头纠正第三方内容。

howto.what_en: Optimizes to be quoted rather than clicked: put answers first, write self-contained paragraphs, keep facts consistent, audit how AI describes your brand, and measure citations/direct traffic instead of sessions.
howto.when_en: Triggers when traffic shifts from links to AI answers, a brand is missing or misrepresented in AI responses, or content planning targets retrieval rather than ranking.

say_en.text: Check whether this page will be cited accurately in AI answers.
say_en.note: Claude audits it against the skill's criteria.

say_en.text: Move the answer to 'what we do' to the first sentence under a real heading.
say_en.note: So the passage stands alone when extracted.

say_en.text: Different AI assistants describe my brand differently—help me trace the source.
say_en.note: Claude shows how to correct the underlying source.
